description: Year of birth (2005-2020) — proxy for the Flynn effect
Parental socioeconomic status composite (0-100) — also a confounder of parent IQ
Mother age at the child's birth
Prenatal iodine status: deficient / mild_low / adequate — deficiency costs ~7-12 IQ pts
Months breastfed (small cognitive association, largely SES-confounded)
Early lead exposure: low / moderate / elevated — dose-dependent harm
Number of books in the home
TARGET (binary): 1 if child IQ in the top decile
